CustomObject.description: First Custom Setting in this repo (design-requirements-attachment-persistence-v2.md §6.6, §10.2 A2, Q-5). Hierarchy Custom Setting backing ContentPublicationBudget — the L5 predictive daily budget (DAILY_PUBLICATION_BUDGET = 1000) and L4 reactive circuit breaker (BREAKER_SUSPEND_HOURS = 24) that shield the org's shared, rolling-24-hour ContentPublicationLimit (2,500) from the async attachment-persistence pipeline (AttachmentPersistQueueable / AttachmentCarrierSweepBatch). Chosen over a custom object specifically because a hierarchy setting read costs zero SOQL. Custom Setting DATA is not deployable — the Apex service creates the org-default row on first use; do not hand-create it in Setup and do not expect a data row in source control. No customSettingsVisibility: unpackaged org, no namespace boundary to govern — see class comment.
CustomObject.label: Content Publication Budget
